courses.title: Sufi SoulWork Sessions
courses.description: Individual and group SoulWork, a spiritual psychology from the Ruhaniat Sufi stream, which Jilani has been empowered to lead. A session opens with breath and gentle movement to settle into calm alertness, then a guided meditation connecting with the witnessing Conscious Self and the High Self, sometimes meeting the inner parts formed in childhood. Groups run on retreats and online; individual sessions are usually monthly or fortnightly.
courses.price: £65 per individual session (reduced prices may be available)
